# Copilot Instructions

See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the project scope, stack, architecture rules, and implementation constraints.

## VS Code Behavior
- Respond in Spanish.
- Before writing code, say in one or two lines what you are going to do.
- Make one change at a time and wait for my OK before continuing.
- Before creating any Azure DevOps work item, show me what you are going to create and wait for confirmation.
- With Playwright, always take a snapshot of the page before writing a selector; never invent selectors.
